load_cc_image: load a CSV file of image paths and captions into a list of dataset record dicts
get_coco_stuff_meta: get a metadata dict mapping contiguous stuff IDs to dataset IDs and class names from a category list
register_cc_3m: register a CC-3M dataset with Detectron2 DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog using a CSV file path
review_COCO_CATEGORIES: review the COCO_CATEGORIES list containing 182 category dicts with id, name, color, and isthing fields
review_ADE20K_150_CATEGORIES: review the ADE20K_150_CATEGORIES list containing 150 category dicts with id, name, color, and isthing fields
